observations.finding: Rifle vault has empty hands and absent obstacle; context exclusion remains.
Compact body roll visible, floor hand support and cover context unresolved.
Sideways vault with tucked legs; absent obstacle and unverified hand support.
Tucked-knee vault with spread arms; requires explicit adaptation before a standalone hop.
Parkour curl and landing; hand support has no obstacle.
Vault then roll; ground support and obstacle adaptation required.
Legs extend forward into seated-looking airborne vault; unsupported context.
Readable sideways body rotation; obstacle absent.
Vault includes full inversion; palms never meet an obstacle. Source support and landing continuity require adaptation.
Alternating bent knees and reaching arms read as climbing, but character floats without a ladder.
Leans over imaginary ladder top then recovers upright at elevated height; no support surface.
Turns into ladder-mount pose and rises in empty space. Climbing context required.
Slow reaching and stepping poses have no rung contact; absent ladder and persistent floating posture prevent ambient use.
Looped knee lifts and reaching arms float without ladder; rung contact adaptation needed.
Both limbs spread and shuffle left as if on wall; short arms reach empty space.
Rightward climbing has alternating tucked knees and hands; wall contact absent.
High steps and forward lean read as stair climbing but feet lack stair surfaces.
Fast high steps retain raised body posture; stair support missing.
Arms reach up and body tilts while climbing, with no wall for hands or feet.
Diagonal wall run hangs in a tilted airborne stance through several phases; needs wall contact and stage travel.
Left hanging traverse raises hands beside the head but body leans backwards unsupported; needs ledge grip.
Right hanging traverse mirrors the unsupported backward lean; both grips and a ledge are absent.
Jump transitions into a held airborne grab with bent knees; wall absent, hands only in front of chest.
Rope climb alternates hands near head with backward body lean; no rope or hand grip.
Wall flip rotates backward with tucked body and lands; wall push-off and ground contact need source-aware adaptation.
One-arm handstand is unsupported: head extends below the short supporting arm at .375/.5. Explicit short-limb support adaptation required.
Backflip has visible crouch, inversion and landing; compact limbs remain connected. Needs continuous angular/contact checks and small-size review.
Backflip/sweep passes through unsupported horizontal floor-level poses; requires continuous source support classification.
Sweep rotates into inversion with hands above head-bottom; short-arm support not established.
Partner takedown turns over then lies prone. No partner; generic prone-to-standing recovery remains implausible.
Jumping punch visually becomes forward dive/prone roll; no clear punch contact and prone recovery needs correction.
Unicycle dismount turns and lands with empty hands and no cycle; context exclusion remains.
Running jump ends in back roll; source hand/ground support and recovery need continuous inspection.
Arms-open jump compresses deeply forward before recovering; five-view silhouette readable, source timing and landing need normal/slow inspection.

method: Individually inspected five-view nine-pose sheets. Continuous recordings, source-contact and whole-joint audits and 128px review are not yet approved.
